title: Write and read a JSON report
hints: json.dump(obj, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) does most of the work; json.load(f) reads it back.
json.dump does not write a trailing newline; call f.write("\n") after it.
Pass default=fn where fn(value) returns a JSON-friendly replacement (isoformat(), sorted(set), str(path)) and raises TypeError otherwise.
